evidence_required: A table with ≥ 12 checks in fail-fast order; every threshold labelled with its evidence class; a total duration estimate; the policy-version field you will record.

marking.criterion: Coverage: ≥ 12 checks spanning discovery, memory, NIC link, storage, thermals, burn-in, NVLink, RDMA pairs, single-node NCCL
Fail-fast order (cheap inventory/topology first, burn-in late, NCCL last)
Thresholds labelled with evidence class; FAIL vs WARN classes correct
Total duration (≈ 25 h with 24 h burn-in) and policy-version field recorded

title: Node acceptance test design
